# Caventra

> Engineering bespoke digital solutions, web applications, and custom cloud infrastructure for growing businesses and startups.

Caventra is a specialized digital solutions and web engineering studio founded and headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Caventra engineers bespoke, hand-crafted software and web applications with zero page-builders, delivering sub-second page performance, 100% client code and IP ownership, enterprise-grade security, and transparent upfront scoping.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Custom Web Development & Engineering](https://caventraofficial.in/services/web-development/): Bespoke full-stack web applications, custom APIs, database engineering, and zero-builder responsive websites.
- [Cloud Hosting & Infrastructure](https://caventraofficial.in/services/hosting/): Ultra-low latency global CDN deployment, automated SSL, isolated database environments, and 99.9% uptime reliability.
- [Website Security & Protection](https://caventraofficial.in/services/security/): Hardened Content Security Policies (CSP), automated DDoS mitigation, form sanitization, penetration testing, and intrusion monitoring.
- [Website Management & Maintenance](https://caventraofficial.in/services/maintenance/): Ongoing technical care, automated database backups, dependency updates, uptime monitoring, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- [Brand Identity & Digital Design](https://caventraofficial.in/services/branding/): Design systems, responsive component libraries, accessible UI/UX, and typography hierarchies.

## Interactive Tools & Case Studies

- [Website Project Cost Estimator](https://caventraofficial.in/estimator/): Interactive estimation tool supporting multi-currency pricing (INR and USD) across 7 project tiers with real-time scope breakdown.
- [Selected Work & Case Studies](https://caventraofficial.in/work/): Production implementations including The Wheel Master ERP, PLINTH real-estate platform, and specialized e-commerce applications.
- [Engineering Blog & Technical Insights](https://caventraofficial.in/blog/): In-depth guides on custom web app costs, US-India engineering partnerships, custom e-commerce vs Shopify, applied AI workflows, zero-bloat Node architecture, and DPDP/GDPR compliance.
